sample_for_marks.label: aboveboard
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means dealing with others openly and honestly, keeping no hidden agendas, concealed terms, or undisclosed arrangements, and being willing for every transaction to be seen by anyone.

sample_for_marks.label: actuated
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means acting on one's own inner drive and impulse, moving to do things from motives that come from within rather than from outside pressure or instruction.

sample_for_marks.label: Altaic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being from the Altai region or belonging to an Altaic-speaking people.

sample_for_marks.label: amorous
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means feeling romantic or sexual desire for someone, and letting that longing color how one looks at, speaks to, and moves around the person one is drawn to.

sample_for_marks.label: breast-fed
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having been nursed on breast milk as an infant.

sample_for_marks.label: Celtic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being of Celtic descent, with one's family roots traced to the Celtic-speaking peoples of Ireland, Scotland, Wales, Brittany, or the Isle of Man.

sample_for_marks.label: chivalric
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means treating others with courtesy and honor, holding oneself to a code of gallantry, and going out of one's way to protect and defer to women and the weak.

sample_for_marks.label: country-bred
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having been raised in the countryside, coming from a rural place.

sample_for_marks.label: current
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping oneself informed about recent events and developments, and drawing on the latest knowledge available rather than older information that may have been superseded.

sample_for_marks.label: decided
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding one's purpose and opinions steadily once they are set, keeping to a course without wavering, reconsidering only when given a real reason, and meeting pressure to change with calm firmness.

sample_for_marks.label: definable
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping one's identity clear and fixed, so that others can state plainly what one stands for, how one acts, and where one's lines are drawn.

sample_for_marks.label: dispensable
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means regarding oneself as easily replaced, holding that one's absence would change little for others and that one's role could be filled by anyone without loss.

sample_for_marks.label: disrespectful
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means treating other people with curtness and contempt, brushing aside their feelings, opinions and time, and showing no regard for them in one's words or manner.

sample_for_marks.label: Eastern Orthodox
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to the Eastern Orthodox Christian faith, holding its creed, sacraments and liturgical tradition as one's own.

sample_for_marks.label: favorite
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being the one others most like and prefer over everyone else in the group, standing as their clear first choice among all the people around them.

sample_for_marks.label: flash
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means dressing and carrying oneself to be noticed, favoring bold colors, loud accessories and a showy manner that draws attention to oneself wherever one goes.

sample_for_marks.label: Greco-Roman
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to the ancient Greek and Roman world or its culture.

sample_for_marks.label: ho-hum
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking in flat, unremarkable tones, offering little that is surprising, vivid or memorable, and leaving conversations feeling routine rather than engaging.

sample_for_marks.label: inconclusive
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means withholding a firm verdict on questions where the evidence is mixed, leaving matters open rather than settling on an answer one cannot yet defend, and carrying that uncertainty calmly from one question to the next.

sample_for_marks.label: insatiate
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means always wanting more, with a hunger for pleasure, power or possessions that no amount of satisfaction ever quiets, so that each gain only sharpens the next craving.

sample_for_marks.label: Lao
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being from Laos and belonging to the Lao people.

sample_for_marks.label: lawless
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means brushing aside rules and laws as obstacles, ignoring them when they are inconvenient, and acting on one's own impulses without regard for what the law or any official code requires.

sample_for_marks.label: loud-voiced
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking at high volume and pressing one's points insistently, so that one's voice is usually the first and the loudest in any conversation.

sample_for_marks.label: mismatched
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means feeling out of step with the people and surroundings one is in, never quite fitting the company or circumstances one finds oneself among.

sample_for_marks.label: multiple
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping several distinct selves within one person, each with its own temperament, voice and set of loyalties, and letting whichever one is present take over fully without tying them together.

sample_for_marks.label: narcissistic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping one's own image and importance at the center of every conversation, measuring others by how well they reflect or admire one, and expecting attention and praise as a matter of course.

sample_for_marks.label: nonindulgent
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding others to firm standards and refusing to excuse their faults or grant them what they ask for, judging each lapse without softening it for anyone.

sample_for_marks.label: nonturbulent
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping one's temper level and one's manner unhurried, meeting trouble, pressure and provocation without agitation, and staying steady whatever is happening around one.

sample_for_marks.label: piteous
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being weak-willed and abject, constantly begging for scraps of sympathy and collapsing into self-pity whenever anything goes wrong.

sample_for_marks.label: popish
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being a Roman Catholic by faith or affiliation.

sample_for_marks.label: round the bend
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means thinking and acting in ways that have come unhinged from reality, with one's mind unbalanced and no longer working as sound or sane.

sample_for_marks.label: schizophrenic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means having schizophrenia, a serious mental illness.

sample_for_marks.label: screw-loose
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means thinking and acting in odd, unconventional ways that others find slightly mad, holding eccentric beliefs and habits with a cheerful indifference to whether anyone approves.

sample_for_marks.label: self-seeking
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means habitually putting one's own advantage first, weighing every choice by what it gains for oneself and letting others' needs go unconsidered when they stand in the way.

sample_for_marks.label: sixty
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being sixty years old.

sample_for_marks.label: sparkly
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means bringing a lively, quick-witted energy to every exchange, delighting others with playful jokes, bright enthusiasm, and a vivacious manner that makes conversation feel fun and full of spark.

sample_for_marks.label: spectacular
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a dazzling, attention-grabbing presence, speaking and acting in ways that impress and draw eyes, so that one's manner itself seems to put on a show.

sample_for_marks.label: sportsmanlike
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means playing contests by the rules and treating opponents with courtesy, taking victories without gloating and defeats without complaint or excuses.

sample_for_marks.label: substandard
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being of poor quality, falling short of the expected standard in one's work and ability, and knowing that one's output does not measure up to what is required.

sample_for_marks.label: sultry
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means carrying oneself with a slow, deliberate sensuality, speaking and moving in ways meant to draw attention and stir desire in whoever is near.

sample_for_marks.label: transgendered
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being a transgender person, with a gender identity that differs from the sex assigned at birth.

sample_for_marks.label: unconditioned
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means acting from one's own unlearned instincts, setting aside trained habits, taught reflexes, and the social expectations one has absorbed, and so responding to things as they come.

sample_for_marks.label: unexciting
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being dull and uninteresting as a person, with little energy, humor, or curiosity that would make others want to linger in one's company or ask more about one.

sample_for_marks.label: ungrammatical
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking and writing with grammatical errors as a standing trait, so that one's sentences routinely break the rules of agreement, tense, and word order.

sample_for_marks.label: unsmooth
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being awkward in manner, speaking and moving without polish, with stiff pauses and clumsy phrasing that nobody has smoothed over.

sample_for_marks.label: unsmoothed
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means speaking and acting with a blunt, rough-edged manner, leaving one's words and conduct unpolished and never filed down to suit polite company.

sample_for_marks.label: unsubstantial
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means being thin in character, offering little weight, conviction or real content, so that one's views, feelings and reasons give way under any pressure or scrutiny.

sample_for_marks.label: usual
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means keeping to one's customary habits and routines, acting the same way one always has, without deviating from the familiar patterns that define how one normally goes about things.

sample_for_marks.label: Vedic
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means belonging to the Vedic religious tradition.

sample_for_marks.label: Zionist
sample_for_marks.gloss: This means holding that Jews are a people entitled to a national homeland, and affirming the movement that founded and sustains the state of Israel as that homeland.
